name: Unrestricted Color Network (UCN) Distillation
definition: A student model (UCN) optimized via knowledge distillation (KD) from a teacher model (PCN) to produce diffuse colors without palette constraints, enabling Non-Photorealistic Style Editing (NPSE).
summary: Unrestricted Color Network Distillation is a knowledge distillation method that trains a student network to replicate a teacher's diffuse color without palette constraints, enabling non-photorealistic style editing while preserving specular lighting effects.
